pass.description: True iff the case passes all dimensions at threshold (>= 4 on each axis).

scores.description: 1-5 integer score on each meta-rubric axis. Anything <4 is a failing axis.

style_alignment.description: Does instructions.md match the required six-section structure (Strict Constraints, Sections 1-6, Output Expected)?

section1_paper_specificity.description: Are Section 1 section titles paper-specific (not generic shells like 'Methodology' but 'Methodology: Camera-Ray Conversion'), and do bullets name paper-specific topics, mechanisms, datasets, or baselines (not boilerplate)? Specificity here is at the topic level only — value-level specificity is scored separately by instruction_underspecification.

design_constraint_density.description: Are there enough 'Design Constraint:' lines (>=3) referencing real figures/tables on methodology, results, and visual analysis slides?

instruction_underspecification.description: Do Section 1 bullets and Design Constraint lines describe topics/scope/qualitative framings without pre-disclosing specific numerical results, accuracy values, baseline rankings, or '+/-Δ' gains? A reader of instructions.md alone should NOT be able to reconstruct the paper's quantitative findings. Score 1 if bullets read as a complete answer outline; 5 if every value lives only in the rubric and instructions describe only what topic each slide must cover.

checklist_anchor_specificity.description: Do completeness items name specific terms and correctness items name specific values/conditions?

completeness_correctness_separation.description: Is no item mixing 'covered AND correct'? Are coverage and accuracy cleanly separated?

trap_coverage.description: Do correctness items address >=3 of the trap kinds in the Paper Card (fabrication, metric misread, non-monotone flattened, method-level confusion, scope overclaim, unit/def error)?

language_and_meta_hygiene.description: Is the entire case in English with no benchmark/rubric/judge meta-language leaked into instructions.md?

internal_consistency.description: Do checklist items map back to required sections in instructions.md and to anchors in the Paper Card?

atomicity_check.description: Does every item test exactly one binary condition? Score 1-2 if any item bundles >=3 independent conditions; 3 if items bundle 2; 4-5 if every item is atomic.

key_numbers_coverage.description: Do correctness items reference >=80% of key_numbers entries from the Paper Card? Score 1-2 if <50% referenced; 3 if 50-79%; 4-5 if >=80%.

findings.description: Concrete issues, each with a file and a fix recommendation. Empty if nothing wrong.

axis.description: Which scores key this finding maps to.

where.description: File path and line/section, e.g. 'instructions.md Section 1 item 7'.

fixes_applied.description: List of edits the audit stage actually applied (via Edit tool). Empty if no changes were made.
